senses.gloss:
1 A belt, girdle,
waistband, zone in general (fig. also);
anything which girds or surrounds;
मही सागरमेखला ‘the sea-girt earth’;
रत्नानुविद्धार्णवमेखलाया दिशः सपत्नी भव
दक्षिणस्याः R. 6. 63; Rs. 6. 2.
--2
Particularly, the girdle or zone of
a woman; नितंबबिंबैः सदुकूलमेखलैः
Rs. 1. 4, 6: R. 8. 64; मेखलागुणैरुत
गोत्रस्खलितेषु बंधनं Ku. 4. 8.
--3 The
triple girdle worn by the first three
castes; cf Ms. 2. 42.
--4 The slope of
a mountain (नितंब); आमेखलं संचरतां
घताना Ku. 1. 5; Me. 12.
--5 The
hips.
--6 A sword-belt.
--7 A
swordknot or string fastened to the hilt.
--8 The girth of a horse.
--9 N. of
the river Narmadā.
--Comp.
--पदं
the hips.
--बंधः investiture with the
girdle.

मेखलिन् m.
1 An epithet of Śiva.
--2 A religious student, a
Brahmachārin, q. v.
